transcript_segments.text: Aaj hum street food ke quality ke baare mein baat karenge
Kabhi kabhi hum notice hi nahi karte khana kaise rakha hota hai
Open mein rakha hua khana hygiene ke liye thoda risky ho sakta hai
Ghar ka bana ya clean jagah ka khana usually zyada safe hota hai
Thoda conscious hona humari health ke liye kaafi important hai

insertions.reason: Opening context about street food quality is reinforced by a Mumbai street food environment shot.
Discussion about everyday food handling matches takeaway food containers in a normal home setting.
Speaker mentions hygiene risks, and this clip visually shows uncovered food at a stall.
Clean kitchen visuals support the point about safer, hygienic food choices.
Closing message about conscious health choices aligns with a calm, healthy dining visual.
